Medium Affected: WATER

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.701667, -105.201667 (Explicit)
Reported Spill Volume: 300 gallons
Report Description
[WEB REPORT] VEHICLE WAS INVOLVED IN A 4 VEHICLE ACCIDENT INVOLVING A TANKER SEMI WHICH WAS WESTBOUND ON COLORADO 6 AND CARRING HOT LIQUID ASPHALT. THE TRUCK WAS COMING INTO A CURVE TO THE RIGHT AND ROLLED 1/4 TIME COUNTER CLOCKWISE AND SLIDING ON ITS LEFT SIDE TO FINAL REST BLOCKING BOTH LANES OF THE HIGHWAY. THE SEMI WAS LEAKING ASPHALT OUT OF THE DOME COVER. THE PRODUCT RAN DOWN AN EMBANKMENT AND INTO CLEAR CREEK. AS THE PRODUCT CAME IN CONTACT WITH THE ICE IT SOLIDIFIED ON TOP OF THE ICE WITH A SMALL AMOUNT SPILLING INTO THE WATER. THE LEAK WAS STOPPED AND THE TANK WAS OFF LOADED ONTO ANOTHER TANKER. THERE WERE 5 INJURIES AND ALL 5 VICTIMS WERE TAKEN TO THE HOSPITAL. NONE OF THE INJURIES WERE DUE TO EXPOSURE TO THE HAZMAT.

Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING A LRV AUTO ACCIDENT THAT WILL REACH OVER THE $25000 REPAIR THRESHOLD. CALLER STATED THE INCIDENT OCCURRED AT A STREET INTERSECTION CONTROLLED BY TRAFFIC LIGHTS AND TRAIN SIGNALIZATION (SCOTT STREET AT HADLEY STREET HOUSTON, TX). THE WESTBOUND LIGHT RAIL VEHICLE ON SEMI-DEDICATED TRACKS ENTERED THE INTERSECTION AND A PRIVATE PASSENGER (SUV) VEHICLE ATTEMPTED AN ILLEGAL LEFT TURN IN FRONT OF THE TRAIN. CALLER STATED THE PASSENGER SUV ATTEMPTED TO MAKE A LEFT TURN IN FRONT OF THE LIGHT RAIL ON RED LIGHT FOR THE PASSENGER SUV. CALLER STATED THERE WERE TWO REPORTED INJURIES. THE DRIVER OF THE SUV WAS TRANSPORTED TO MEMORIAL HERMAN HOSPITAL WITH NON SERIOUS INJURIES. THE DRIVER OF THE PASSENGER SUV HAS FACIAL INJURIES DUE TO THE DEPLOYMENT OF THE AIR BAG IN THE PASSENGER VEHICLE AND THE OPERATOR OF THE LIGHT RAIL WENT TO THE HOSPITAL (ST LUKES HOSPITAL) DUE TO ANXIETY. CALLER STATED THERE WERE OTHER PASSENGERS (3) IN THE VEHICLE BUT THEY DID NOT REPORT ANY INJURIES AND THEY WERE NOT TRANSPORTED TO THE HOSPITAL. ONLY THE DRIVER OF THE PASSENGER SUV WAS TRANSPORTED TO THE HOSPITAL. CALLER STATED THE DAMAGE AMOUNT WILL EXCEED $25000. THERE WAS A 50 MINUTE DELAY FOR SERVICE SO PASSENGER ON THE LIGHT RAIL WERE OFFLOADED FOR ALTERNATE SERVICE.

REPORT DATE: 06-08-2021 REPORT TIME: 0331 UTC REGION: GULF OF MEXICO SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: WEST CAMERON 537 IMAGE DATE: 06-07-2021 IMAGE TIME: 1648 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL2B MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 10 METER LOCATION: 28°19"58" N/93°12"52" W AREA: 32.96 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THE ANOMALY IS BELIEVED TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH NRC INCIDENT REPORT # 1307097 AND EXTENDS FOR APPROXIMATELY 12.1 NM THE ANOMALY APPEARED BRIGHT AGAINST THE OCEAN BACKGROUND WITH AND WAS INDICATIVE OF AN OIL SHEEN IN RGB IMAGERY. LOCAL WIND DATA INDICATES THAT WINDS WERE OUT OF THE S AT APPROXIMATELY 10 KTS AND ALIGNS WITH THE ORIENTATION OF THE ANOMALY. properties.title: NRC Report: Gasoline: Automotive (Unleaded) near Elfrida, AZ
properties.summary: Incident Type: MOBILE - NRC Report ID: 897578 - Medium Affected: SOIL - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 897578
Incident Time: 2009-02-15 22:42:00
Nearest City: Elfrida, AZ
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: GASOLINE: AUTOMOTIVE (UNLEADED)
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 20 gallons
DRIVER WAS TRAVELING SOUTH THRU THE TOWN OF ELFRIDA ARIZONA WHEN THE MOTORIST AHEAD PULLED TO THE SHOULDER. THE DRIVER SLOWED AS HE APPROACHED THE VEHICLE. THE MOTORIST THEN MADE A U-TURN AND STRUCK OUR UNIT IN THE PASSENGER SIDE WHICH CAUSED THE PLUMBING TO COME OFF OF THE TRAILER RESULTING IN A SPILL OF PRODUCT ON THE ROAD. THE AMOUNT INVOLVED WAS 15 GALLONS WHICH WAS IMMEDIATELY CONTAINED BY THE DRIVER WITH A SPILL KIT. POLICE AND FIRE DEPARTMENT WAS DISPATCHED TO THE SCENE AND THERE WERE NO INJURIES. THE MOTORIST DID ADMIT GUILT AND WILL BE CITED FOR AN ILLEGAL LANE U-TURN AND FAILURE TO SEE ONCOMING TRAFFIC. SAFETY IS EN-ROUTE TO ASSIST IN OFF-LOADING THE TRUCK, AND THE MOTORIST VEHICLE WAS TOWED FROM THE SCENE.
